name: hermes-web-gateway
description: Local OpenAI-compatible router for Hermes using signed-in browser web sessions

scripts.test: npm run build --silent && node --test tests/*.test.mjs gateway/tests/*.test.mjs && python -m unittest discover -s companion/tests -v && python -m unittest discover -s gateway/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm audit --audit-level=low
